# Extract Business Rules

## Objective
Extract explicit and implicit recommendation rules from code and docs.

## Context
See `.cursor/rules/business-rules.md` and `.cursor/context/project-goals.md`.

## Instructions
1. Explicit rules (top-K, filter seen items, temporal split)
2. Implicit rules from code
3. Ambiguities needing team validation (cold start policy)

## Output
Structured rules list + test recommendations
